Package org.tweetyproject.logics.pcl.analysis

Class DistanceMinimizationInconsistencyMeasure

java.lang.Object
org.tweetyproject.logics.commons.analysis.BeliefSetInconsistencyMeasure<ProbabilisticConditional>
org.tweetyproject.logics.pcl.analysis.DistanceMinimizationInconsistencyMeasure
All Implemented Interfaces:
PostulateEvaluatable<ProbabilisticConditional>, InconsistencyMeasure<BeliefSet<ProbabilisticConditional,?>>
Direct Known Subclasses:
NormalizedDistanceMinimizationInconsistencyMeasure
public class DistanceMinimizationInconsistencyMeasure extends BeliefSetInconsistencyMeasure<ProbabilisticConditional>
This class models the distance minimization inconsistency measure as proposed in [Thimm,UAI,2009], extended by the use of different p-norms.
Author:
Matthias Thimm
